title: Constructed ordinary integral and rational signed line comparisons
statement: For the point Tate section carriers and fixed composites [def-pur-point-tate-comparison-data], define canonicalSheaf by the inverse ordinary-model comparison [lem-weil-isomorphism-comparison-scalar-extension] followed by the normalized signed line isomorphism [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Define canonicalIntegral by the sections-tensor isomorphism [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension] followed by sections of canonicalSheaf. Define canonicalRational by the inverse localization-tensor associator followed by rationalization of canonicalIntegral. All three use the prime made invertible on the point [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. These are real composites of fixed isomorphisms and contain no arbitrary choice of basis. Their recorded API evaluates them on completed scalar tensor sections [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] and on section tensors along the integer-ring inclusions [def-weil-pbc-integer-quotient-inclusions], and proves the identity and tower equations.
